purpose: Sensor Systems & Telemetry Integration normalized packet handoff for ML lead SAME-R HKP time-series inputs
ownership: Raw ML data, feature engineering, trained models and evaluation remain the ML lead’s work. Sensor Systems & Telemetry Integration only preserves, maps, validates and packetizes inputs.
packet_grain: one packet per (TestNumber, Time) after applying the ML lead loader duplicate/drop rules
time_semantics: source_epoch_s is the CSV 'Time' column: Unix epoch seconds. It was validated against the GMT time_string in all 58,386 packets and is promoted to timestamp_utc as ISO-8601 UTC. source_epoch_s remains preserved unchanged; elapsed_test_time_s remains seconds since test start.
preprocessing_warning: Packets contain mapped raw channels. They are not model-ready feature matrices: the ML lead preprocessing applies per-test baseline correction, trailing 5/10/30-second rolling features, and classifier ratios. Do not feed raw packets directly to trained models without that exact preprocessing.

sentinel_rules.packet_behavior: preserve raw file unchanged; normalized channel ptrak is null and quality flag is emitted for -999

integrity: raw CSV SHA-256 checksums are in SAME_R_RAW_FILE_INVENTORY.csv
